name: Supplier prices stable
explanation: The owner reports stable supplier prices, so a supplier price rise is not the cause of high food cost (check wastage, portions and menu instead).

name: Customer visits stable or growing
explanation: Customer visits changed by {customers_change_pct:.1f}%: demand is not falling.

name: Food wastage low
explanation: Wastage is only about {wastage_pct:.0f}%, so food wastage is unlikely to be a problem.

name: Labour cost normal and staffing aligned
explanation: Labour cost is {labour_cost_ratio:.1f}% of sales and staffing follows demand, so a staffing mismatch is unlikely.

name: Healthy cash buffer and current ratio
explanation: Cash covers {cash_buffer_months:.1f} months of expenses and the current ratio is {current_ratio:.2f}: liquidity is healthy.

name: Low debt and light repayment burden
explanation: Debt is low relative to equity and instalments are a small share of sales, so debt is unlikely to be the problem.

name: Rent is a small share of sales
Weekend load per staff member is comfortable
explanation: {weekend_customers_per_staff:.1f} customers per staff member on weekends is manageable.

name: Repeat customers stable or increasing
explanation: Repeat customers are holding up, so poor retention is less likely.

name: Average bill steady and discounts small
explanation: The average bill is not falling and discounts are small ({discount_pct:.0f}%).

name: Food cost normal and steady
explanation: Food cost is {food_cost_ratio:.1f}% of sales and per-customer cost is steady, so rising food cost is unlikely.

name: Stock levels healthy and no shortages
explanation: Stock covers {inventory_days:.0f} days and items never run out: inventory control looks sound.

name: Gross margin healthy
explanation: Gross margin is {gross_margin_pct:.1f}%, so the menu mix is earning enough.

name: Food is prepared according to demand
explanation: Preparation already follows demand, so over-preparation is a less likely cause of waste (look at expiry and over-buying instead).
